lines.en: label sportswars8:
scene sky
{i}And so she did...{/i}
lines.zh: {i}于是她这么做了……{/i}

lines.en: {i}Just not really.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}只是，并没有真的做到。{/i}

lines.en: {i}You see, making friends is way harder than it seems when you’re observing the inner and outer circles of a bunch of girls who, for the most part, need companionship in order to survive.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}你瞧，当你旁观一群大多需要陪伴才能活下去的女孩所组成的内圈与外圈时，交朋友远比看上去要难得多。{/i}

lines.en: {i}But, at the same time, if you’re one of those mythical “extroverts,” you’re probably reading this right now and thinking to yourself, “Well, it’s never been that hard for me!”{/i}
lines.zh: {i}但与此同时，如果你是那种传说中的「外向者」，你此刻大概正在读这段话，并在心里想着：「嗯，这对我来说从来都不难啊！」{/i}

lines.en: {i}And the reason for that is simple — you live in the moment. But you live in a way that disallows you to see more than five minutes into the future. And hey, maybe that’s okay for you.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}原因很简单——你活在当下。只是你的活法让你无法看到五分钟之后的未来。嘿，也许这对你来说没什么不好。{/i}

lines.en: {i}Maybe that makes you happy.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}也许这让你快乐。{/i}

lines.en: {i}After all, when the opposing side’s world-view is more typically synonymous with staring so far into the future that they lose sight of the present altogether, extroversion sounds pretty tempting.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}毕竟，当对立一方的世界观更像是死盯着遥远的未来、以至于彻底看不见现在时，外向听起来就相当诱人了。{/i}

lines.en: {i}None of this is to say those personality types are confined to this alone, though. There’s a lot more that goes into both of them, I’m sure. And this is just one person’s paraphrased interpretation of them.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}不过，这并不是说这些性格类型就仅限于此。我敢肯定，两者都还有更多东西。而这也只是某个人对它们的转述式解读。{/i}

lines.en: {i}I guess all I’m saying is that just because some things are easy for some people doesn’t mean that it’s like that for everyone.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}我想我真正想说的是，有些事对某些人来说很容易，不代表对所有人都是如此。{/i}

lines.en: {i}If you want to see that as weakness, fine. I know doing that makes me feel a little better about myself sometimes, so it’s not like I’ll blame you or anything if that’s the path you want to take.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}如果你要把这看成软弱，随你。我知道这么做有时会让我自己好受一点，所以如果你想走这条路，我也不会怪你什么的。{/i}

lines.en: {i}I just want to urge you to maybe think outside of the box sometimes since what’s inside might not be all it's cracked up to be.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}我只是想劝你，也许偶尔跳出框框想一想——因为框里的东西，未必真有传说的那么好。{/i}

lines.en: {i}Regardless, in the white-haired girl’s half-desperate plea for someone to listen to her, things begin to bubble up.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}无论如何，在那个白发女孩几近绝望地祈求有人倾听她的过程中，某些东西开始泛起气泡。{/i}

lines.en: {i}Some of the others wonder if it’s worth it. Some have already made up their minds. Some might even already see her as a friend.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}有些人怀疑这值不值得。有些人已经打定了主意。有些人甚至可能已经把她当成了朋友。{/i}

lines.en: {i}But that’s not the way that girl sees anyone. Even Touka, the one who has essentially become a stand-in mother figure for Yasu, was not exactly a “friend” in her somewhat-seeing eyes.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}但那并不是那个女孩看待任何人的方式。就连 Touka——那个几乎已经成为 Yasu 代理母亲般的存在——在她那双勉强能视物的眼里，也并不算是「朋友」。{/i}

lines.en: {i}She was more like a shadow. Something both real and not real at the same time. An entity that, while taking up visual space, was naught more than a distortion in the grand scheme of things.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}她更像是一道影子。某种既真实又不真实的东西。一个虽然占据着视觉空间、但在宏大的图景中不过是一道扭曲的存在。{/i}

lines.en: {i}But what is that scheme, you ask?{/i}
lines.zh: {i}可你问，那个宏大的图景是什么？{/i}

lines.en: {i}And it’s a good question.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}这是个好问题。{/i}

lines.en: : Okay, everyone! It’s time for the next competition!
lines.zh: : 好了，各位！下一个项目的时间到了！

lines.en: {i}But it’s one that won’t be answered until later.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}但这个问题要等到以后才会有答案。{/i}

lines.en: scene imaniscavenge1
{i}I’m sure you’ve probably already come to expect that, though.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}不过我敢说，你们大概早就料到了。{/i}

lines.en: {i}Answers never come easy around here, do they?{/i}
lines.zh: {i}在这儿，答案从来来得不容易，不是吗？{/i}

lines.en: {i}And besides, even when your questions are answered, you like to pretend they’re not because the idea of closure is kind of intimidating. It’s a little bit scary.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}再说，就算问题得到了答案，你们也喜欢假装没有——因为「了结」这个概念本身就有点吓人。是挺可怕的。{/i}

lines.en: {i}But it’s nothing like living in a world where you constantly lose sight of the present.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}但这远比不上活在一个不断看不见当下的世界里。{/i}

lines.en: {i}I hope, from the bottom of my heart-{/i}
lines.zh: {i}我从心底希望——{/i}

lines.en: {i}That you never have to deal with those bubbles.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}你永远不必去应付那些气泡。{/i}

lines.en: : First and foremost, I’d like to ask all of our viewers at home to kindly forget anything they may have heard when I was talking to my friends a few minutes ago.
lines.zh: : 首先，我想请家里的各位观众行行好，忘掉几分钟前我和朋友们交谈时可能听到的任何内容。

lines.en: : I can assure you that I am perfectly sane. But since assuring you of my sanity probably makes me sound {i}insane{/i} instead, forget I said that too!
lines.zh: : 我可以向你们保证，我神智完全正常。不过，既然向你们保证我正常这件事大概只会让我听起来更{i}不正常{/i}，那这句话也请一并忘掉！

lines.en: : Miss Imai...the scavenger hunt?
lines.zh: : Imai 老师……寻宝赛呢？

lines.en: scene imaniscavenge2
: Right!
: With the current contest tied at two points apiece, this next one, a sports day classic, will determine who heads into the second half of the day with an advantage!
lines.zh: : 目前比赛以两分打成平手，而下一个项目——运动会的经典项目——将决定谁能带着优势进入下半场！

lines.en: : And while that advantage could be thrown out of the window at any moment, it’ll definitely add to the weight of things given that there are now {i}two{/i} absent members of the first floor.
lines.zh: : 虽然这个优势随时可能被抛出窗外，但鉴于一楼现在已经有{i}两{/i}名成员缺席，它无疑会让局势更加沉重。

lines.en: : This “one point deduction for everyone who doesn’t participate” thing is pretty rough, huh? Extra work {i}while{/i} getting slapped with that can’t be a fun combination.
lines.zh: : 这个「不参加的人每人扣一分」的规定挺狠的，是吧？额外干活{i}还要{/i}被扣这么一下，凑在一起肯定不好受。

lines.en: : It’s not...but I understand the reasoning for it. Sports day is all about working as a team and, if there are any weak links, it only makes sense that everyone has to pay for it.
lines.zh: : 确实不好受……但我理解这么做的道理。运动会就是要讲团队合作，要是有人拖后腿，所有人都得为此付出代价，这也说得通。

lines.en: scene imaniscavenge3
: Exactly! Just don’t let those words get in the way of the fact that the scavenger hunt is going to be an individual competition and doesn’t have much to do with teamwork at all!
lines.zh: : 正是！只是别让那些话盖过了一个事实——寻宝赛是个人赛，跟团队合作没多大关系！

lines.en: : It kind of {i}vaguely{/i} does in the sense that we had to elect who’d be participating, right?
lines.zh: : 从「我们得先选出参赛人选」这个意义上说，{i}多少也算{/i}有点关系吧？

lines.en: scene imaniscavenge4
: Sure! But anything can mean {i}anything{/i} so long as you’re really vague about it.
lines.zh: : 当然！不过只要你说得够含糊，{i}什么都{/i}能是什么意思。

lines.en: : Just look at the entire existence of modern art. We live in a world where you can accidentally spill your coffee on a canvas and then sell it for millions of dollars in the right setting.
lines.zh: : 看看整个现代艺术的存在就知道了。我们活在一个世界里：你失手把咖啡洒在画布上，只要场合对，就能卖到几百万美元。

lines.en: : Is this really the time and place to be having a discussion on modern art?
lines.zh: : 现在真的是讨论现代艺术的时机和场合吗？

lines.en: : No! Which is why I will now explain the rules of the competition for anyone at home who needs a quick refresher!
lines.zh: : 不是！所以我现在就为家里需要快速复习一下的观众讲解比赛规则！

lines.en: scene imaniscavenge5
: Just behind us, you’ll find a bunch of note cards scattered all over the ground.
lines.zh: : 就在我们身后，你会发现地上散落着一大堆卡片。

lines.en: : Each one of these note cards has something you’ll need to find written on the back, and they were all written based on suggestions from our viewers.
lines.zh: : 每张卡片的背面都写着你们需要找到的东西，而这些都是根据观众的建议写出来的。

lines.en: : And while that was fun and all, it also taught me that there are some {i}really{/i} creepy people who watch our show! So please note that these have been heavily censored.
lines.zh: : 虽然这挺有意思，但它也让我明白，看我们节目的观众里有一些{i}真的{/i}很变态的人！所以请注意，这些内容已经经过严格审查。

lines.en: : {i}Heavily{/i} censored. You’re welcome.
lines.zh: : {i}严格{/i}审查过了。不用谢。

lines.en: : Maybe we should stop televising this event?
lines.zh: : 也许我们不该再转播这个活动了？

lines.en: : Maybe! But anyway, all you two need to do is overturn those cards one at a time, collect the object on the card, and bring it back to the center circle to gain a point!
lines.zh: : 也许吧！总之，你们俩要做的就是一次翻开一张卡片，收集卡片上写的东西，带回中央圆圈就得一分！

lines.en: : The contest will immediately come to an end after one of you reaches three points, but beware! For there are some things on these cards that will be very hard to find!
lines.zh: : 只要有一方拿到三分，比赛立刻结束，不过要当心！因为有些卡片上的东西会非常难找！

lines.en: : Can we just...get a new card if the object on the one we overturn looks too hard?
lines.zh: : 如果我们翻开的卡片上写的东西看起来太难找，能不能……换一张？

lines.en: : Nope! You’ve just gotta chalk it up to bad luck and deal with it. That’s life, girls.
lines.zh: : 不行！你们只能认命当作运气不好，然后硬着头皮上。这就是人生啊，姑娘们。

lines.en: : So when do we-
lines.zh: : 那我们什么时候——

lines.en: scene sky
: Ah!
: Ah!
: Ah!
: Sorry, Miku! Go, Futaba! Go, Otoha! Fight to the death in heavily-censored fashion!
lines.zh: : 抱歉，Miku！加油，Futaba！加油，Otoha！在严格审查之下战斗到死吧！

lines.en: scene imaniscavenge6
: Um...Otoha?
lines.zh: : 呃……Otoha？

lines.en: : Hey.
: What are you doing?
lines.zh: : 你在干什么？

lines.en: : Preventing you from flipping over this card.
lines.zh: : 阻止你翻开这张卡片。

lines.en: : Oh...okay.
lines.zh: : 哦……好吧。

lines.en: : Why?
lines.zh: : 为什么？

lines.en: : Because I figure that if I can wear you down and just prevent you from picking up {i}any{/i} cards to begin with that I’ll be able to outlast you and ultimately win. It’s nothing personal.
lines.zh: : 因为我在想，只要我能耗到你筋疲力尽、从一开始就让你拿不到{i}任何{/i}卡片，我就能比你撑得更久，最终获胜。这无关私人恩怨。

lines.en: : So you just...won’t pick up any cards yourself until...I’m tired?
lines.zh: : 所以你就……一直不拿卡片，直到……我累了为止？

lines.en: : That’s the plan.
lines.zh: : 计划就是这样。

lines.en: : And...if I don’t get tired? Then what?
lines.zh: : 那……要是我不会累呢？那怎么办？

lines.en: : I don’t know.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。

lines.en: : It’s not a well thought out plan. I just saw you reaching for this one and reacted instinctively.
lines.zh: : 这不是一个深思熟虑的计划。我只是看到你伸手去拿这张，本能地就出手了。

lines.en: scene imaniscavenge7
: Why is your first instinct to sabotage me?!
lines.zh: : 为什么你的第一反应是来妨碍我？！

lines.en: : I don’t know, Futaba! I’ve been learning a lot of things about myself lately and I don’t like any of them! Just chalk this up to another character flaw and find another card!
lines.zh: : 我不知道，Futaba！我最近认识到了很多关于自己的事，而我一点都不喜欢它们！就当这是我另一个性格缺陷，去找别的卡片吧！

lines.en: : But I want {i}this{/i} one!
lines.zh: : 可我就要{i}这{/i}一张！

lines.en: : There are like fifty fucking cards on the ground! Just pick {i}any{/i} of them! It doesn’t matter!
lines.zh: : 地上他妈有大概五十张卡片！{i}随便{/i}挑一张就行！哪张都无所谓！

lines.en: : You heard her! Let go!
lines.zh: : 你听见她说的了！松手！

lines.en: : I can’t! It’s a matter of principle at this point!
lines.zh: : 我做不到！事到如今，这是原则问题！

lines.en: scene imaniscavenge8
: Aaaahhhh fine! Take your stupid card! I’ll take {i}this{/i} one instead!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊啊——行吧！拿你那张蠢卡片去！我换{i}这{/i}张！

lines.en: : Ha! You shouldn’t have let go so easily, Otoha! Because now, all I have to find is- oh. {i}What?{/i} Why?
lines.zh: : 哈！你不该这么轻易就松手的，Otoha！因为现在我要找的东西只是——哦。{i}什么{/i}？为什么？

lines.en: : Ha! It was a diversionary tactic all along! Good luck, Futaba! You’ve fallen for my trap!
lines.zh: : 哈！这从头到尾都是调虎离山之计！祝你好运，Futaba！你中了我的圈套！

lines.en: : Don’t pretend that you did this on purpose, Otoha! I know your games!
lines.zh: : 别装成你是故意的，Otoha！我懂你的把戏！

lines.en: : She won’t rest until she’s destroyed our entire dorm, Futaba! Don’t let it get to you!
lines.zh: : 不把咱们整栋宿舍搅个天翻地覆她是不会罢休的，Futaba！别让她影响到你！

lines.en: : What kinda stuff do ya think our viewers are makin’ the girls look for?
lines.zh: : 你们觉得观众会让姑娘们去找些啥东西？

lines.en: : I’m not sure. But I do know that Imani asked to borrow some money from me so she could buy supplies. I think Touka wound up covering it, though.
lines.zh: : 我不确定。不过我知道 Imani 找我借过钱买物资。不过最后好像是 Touka 垫付的。

lines.en: : Is that...what all of those crates are for?
lines.zh: : 那些板条箱……就是用来装那些的？

lines.en: : I know my mom donated at least one box worth of {i}supplies{/i} this year. I have no idea what they were for, though.
lines.zh: : 我知道我妈今年至少捐了一箱{i}物资{/i}。不过我不知道那是用来干什么的。

lines.en: scene imaniscavenge9
: Yeah, I think I might know.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我大概知道了。

lines.en: : You okay, Rin? You look nervous.
lines.zh: : 你还好吗，Rin？你看起来很紧张。

lines.en: : My best friend and my ex are competing in a fight to the death right now. Of course I’m nervous.
lines.zh: : 我最好的朋友和我的前任正在一场生死搏斗里对决。我当然紧张。

lines.en: : I don’t...think it’s...to the death, Rin...
lines.zh: : 我倒不觉得……是生死搏斗，Rin……

lines.en: : Until one of them flips over a card that says “murder” and they’re forced to do something they’d probably never do under normal circumstances.
lines.zh: : 除非她们其中一人翻到写着「谋杀」的卡片，被迫去做正常情况下大概绝不会做的事。

lines.en: : And I only say “probably” because you never know when someone is going to turn out to be a serial killer and I can never rule out that possibility for anyone.
lines.zh: : 我之所以说「大概」，是因为你永远不知道谁会突然变成连环杀手，而我从来不会对任何人排除这种可能性。

lines.en: scene imaniscavenge10
: Correct me if I’m wrong...but don’t you, like...collect skulls and shit? Wouldn’t that make you the prime suspect for something like that?
lines.zh: : 要是我说错了请纠正我……不过你不是会……收集骷髅之类的吗？那不就让你成了这类事情的头号嫌疑人？

lines.en: : Only as decorations! If Euronymous from Mayhem can make necklaces out of his bandmate’s skull then surely I can put a few unidentified ones on my shelf without evoking suspicion, can’t I?
lines.zh: : 只是当装饰品！既然 Mayhem 乐队的 Euronymous 都能用队友的头骨做成项链，那我把几个身份不明的头骨摆在架子上，总不至于招来怀疑吧？

lines.en: : I’d make a bone necklace. That sounds kind of fun.
lines.zh: : 我会做一串骨头项链。听起来还挺好玩的。

lines.en: : I feel like...there have been a lot of references...most people won’t understand lately...
lines.zh: : 我总觉得……最近的梗……大部分人都听不懂……

lines.en: : Done! Imani, look!
lines.zh: : 完成！Imani，你看！

lines.en: : M-Me too!
lines.zh: : 我……我也好了！

lines.en: scene imaniscavenge11
: But why a sword?...
lines.zh: : 可为什么是一把剑？……

lines.en: : Otoha! You were first! What was written on your card?
lines.zh: : Otoha！你是第一个！你卡片上写的是什么？

lines.en: : Please tell me it was something flattering and not “annoying Irish girl whose screen-time has really tapered off lately.”
lines.zh: : 请告诉我是些好听的话，而不是「最近戏份明显变少的烦人爱尔兰女孩」。

lines.en: : Something white!
lines.zh: : 白色的东西！

lines.en: scene imaniscavenge12
: There had to have been easier alternatives than {i}me!{/i}
lines.zh: : 总该有比{i}我{/i}更容易找到的替代品吧！

lines.en: : There were. But I figured you might enjoy being princess carried and thought I had some spare time since Futaba seemed worried about her card.
lines.zh: : 有是有。不过我觉得你可能会喜欢被公主抱，而且看 Futaba 似乎在为她的卡片发愁，我想我还有点空闲时间。

lines.en: scene imaniscavenge13
: I think I love you.
lines.zh: : 我想我爱上你了。

lines.en: : Don’t even think about it, Molly!
lines.zh: : 想都别想，Molly！

lines.en: : Futaba! What did your card say?
lines.zh: : Futaba！你的卡片上写了什么？

lines.en: : {i}Sword?{/i}
scene sky
: Points awarded to both of you! The score is even at one point each! Now go get your new cards and-
lines.zh: : 两位各得一分！比分一比一打平！现在去拿你们的新卡片，然后——

lines.en: : Fuck! Where the hell am I going to get one of these?!
lines.zh: : 操！我到底要去哪儿弄这玩意儿？！

lines.en: : Otoha! Did you really have to drop me?! Has my love been that poorly received {i}again?!{/i}
lines.zh: : Otoha！你非得把我扔下来吗？！我的爱就这么不受待见吗？！

lines.en: : Oh! This should be much easier! Thank you, mystery viewer!
lines.zh: : 哦！这个应该好找多了！谢谢你，神秘观众！

lines.en: : Go, Futaba! Go! Just two more points left!
lines.zh: : 加油，Futaba！加油！还差两分！

lines.en: scene imaniscavenge14
: Fuck her up, Otoha! Just not in a violent or mean way because Futaba is our precious cupcake and hurting her is cause for exile!
lines.zh: : 干翻她，Otoha！只是别用暴力或刻薄的方式，因为 Futaba 是我们珍贵的纸杯蛋糕，伤了她是要被流放的！

lines.en: : She’s much more than just a “cupcake,” Noriko. She’s a sunlit cobweb in the corner of your grandmother’s cottage that you look to for comfort following her passing.
lines.zh: : 她可远不只是「纸杯蛋糕」而已，Noriko。她是祖母小屋角落里一张被阳光照亮的蜘蛛网——在她离世之后，你望着它寻求慰藉。

lines.en: : She’s got nice tits.
lines.zh: : 她的胸也很好看。

lines.en: : That too.
lines.zh: : 这也是。

lines.en: : Guys, where is Otoha going?
lines.zh: : 各位，Otoha 要去哪儿？

lines.en: : I think I have an idea, but I don’t want to spoil the surprise.
lines.zh: : 我大概猜到了，但我不想剧透。

lines.en: scene imaniscavenge15
: I have returned! And with a slightly hotter body temperature!
lines.zh: : 我回来了！而且体温稍微升高了一点！

lines.en: : We called that “the Otoha Effect” at our old school. Only a handful of us were immune.
lines.zh: : 我们在以前的学校管这叫「Otoha 效应」。只有少数几个人免疫。

lines.en: : It appears that you have been charmed, Emerald Guardian. Perhaps your normal status will be recovered after our next short rest?
lines.zh: : 看来你被魅惑了，翡翠守护者。也许在下一次短暂休息之后，你的正常状态就能恢复？

lines.en: : One can not simply get rid of the Otoha Effect. It’s a thing you must live with from that point on.
lines.zh: : Otoha 效应可不是说摆脱就能摆脱的。从那一刻起，你就得带着它过一辈子。

lines.en: : I still have dreams about her sometimes. But I have accepted that some things can simply never be.
lines.zh: : 我到现在偶尔还会梦见她。但我已经接受了，有些事就是永远不可能。

lines.en: scene imaniscavenge16

: If I may ask, what exactly about Otoha makes her as appealing as she apparently is to other girls? Because, despite never talking to her at our previous school, I never mistook her for a {i}male.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我能问一下吗，Otoha 到底哪一点让她在别的女孩眼里这么有魅力？因为虽然我在以前的学校从没跟她说过话，我却从没把她误认为{i}男生{/i}。

lines.en: : I don’t think any of us {i}mistook{/i} her for a male. Most of us are just also attracted to girls.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我们谁都没把她{i}误认{/i}成男生。我们大多数人只是同时也喜欢女生。

lines.en: : Is bisexuality really that common in today’s society?
lines.zh: : 双性恋在当今社会真的这么普遍吗？

lines.en: : Are you not at all interested in girls, Touka? Like...not even a little?
lines.zh: : 你对女生一点兴趣都没有吗，Touka？就……一点点都没有？

lines.en: : I can admire beauty when I see it. For example, I think Tsuneyo is extraordinarily attractive.
lines.zh: : 看到美我也会欣赏。比如说，我觉得 Tsuneyo 非常有魅力。

lines.en: : Thanks, bro.
lines.zh: : 谢啦，兄弟。

lines.en: : You’re welcome, bro. But I am not attracted {i}to{/i} her. Are all of you saying that you {i}are?{/i}
lines.zh: : 不客气，兄弟。但我并不{i}被她{/i}吸引。你们是在说，你们{i}都被吸引了{/i}吗？

lines.en: scene imaniscavenge17
: Yeah.
lines.zh: : 是啊。

lines.en: : Absolutely.
lines.zh: : 绝对的。

lines.en: : Oh yeah.
lines.zh: : 哦当然。

lines.en: : God yes.
lines.zh: : 天哪，是的。

lines.en: : Affirmative.
lines.zh: : 肯定。

lines.en: : Interesting.
lines.zh: : 有意思。

lines.en: : Being the most desirable cast member is such a burden sometimes.
lines.zh: : 当全剧组最抢手的角色，有时候真是一种负担。

lines.en: : Otoha, what the fuck?!
lines.zh: : Otoha，你他妈在搞什么？！

lines.en: scene imaniscavenge18
: It appears that my largest contribution to this event has been discovered.
lines.zh: : 看来我对本次活动最大的贡献被发现了。

lines.en: scene imaniscavenge19
: Get out of the way!
lines.zh: : 让开！

lines.en: : Where did you get that?!
lines.zh: : 你从哪儿弄来的？！

lines.en: : I found it!
lines.zh: : 我找到的！

lines.en: : Where?!
lines.zh: : 在哪儿？！

lines.en: : I just did, okay?! Now, get out of the frickin’ way before I kill you! I’m not certified to drive this thing!
lines.zh: : 我就是找到了，好吗？！现在赶紧给我让开，不然我撞死你！我可没有开这玩意儿的资格证！

lines.en: : Futaba! What was on your card?!
lines.zh: : Futaba！你卡片上写了什么？！

lines.en: scene imaniscavenge20
: Flowers!
: Otoha!
lines.zh: : Otoha！

lines.en: : Forklift!
lines.zh: : 叉车！

lines.en: : Imani, I’ve been gone for ten minutes.
lines.zh: : Imani，我才离开了十分钟。

lines.en: scene imaniscavenge21
: How have you managed to create such a disturbance within that minuscule timeframe?
lines.zh: : 你是怎么在这么短的时间里闹出这么大动静的？

lines.en: : You call it a disturbance. {i}I{/i} call it awesome.
lines.zh: : 你管这叫闹腾。{i}我{/i}管这叫牛逼。

lines.en: : I’ll be damned. Your lack of sexual contact has transitioned into such a deep state of hysteria that I can’t help but feel like I should take care of you myself.
lines.zh: : 我真是服了。你缺乏性生活的状态已经演变成如此深沉的歇斯底里，让我忍不住觉得该由我亲自来「照顾」你。

lines.en: scene imaniscavenge22
: Lucky for you, I’ve already come up with a gameplan on how we can convince Osako! First, you have to blindfold her. {i}Then-{/i}
lines.zh: : 算你走运，我已经想好了一套说服 Osako 的方案！首先，你得把她蒙上眼睛。{i}然后{/i}——

lines.en: : Imani, I was kidding.
lines.zh: : Imani，我开玩笑的。

lines.en: : Yeah.
: Me too.
lines.zh: : 我也是。

lines.en: scene imaniscavenge23
: I am so lonely.
lines.zh: : 我好孤独。

lines.en: : Miss Imai!
lines.zh: : Imai 老师！

lines.en: scene imaniscavenge24
: Huh? What?
lines.zh: : 啊？什么？

lines.en: : I need to steal you for a second.
lines.zh: : 我需要把你借用一下。

lines.en: : Fucking forklift! If I didn’t have to park it, I’d already have my third card by now too!
lines.zh: : 该死的叉车！要不是我还得把它停好，我这会儿早就拿到第三张卡片了！

lines.en: : This for the scavenger hunt?
lines.zh: : 这是寻宝赛要用的？

lines.en: : Is that not obvious?
lines.zh: : 这还不明显吗？

lines.en: : It is. But, fair warning — I don’t care {i}how{/i} precious and lovable you are. If that card says “something black,” I ain’t afraid to slap a bitch.
lines.zh: : 是很明显。不过先说清楚——不管你{i}多{/i}珍贵多可爱，要是那张卡片上写着「黑色的东西」，我也不介意扇你一巴掌。

lines.en: scene imaniscavenge25
: It’s not “something black.” Just...
lines.zh: : 不是「黑色的东西」。只是……

lines.en: scene black
: Come with me...
lines.zh: : 跟我来……

lines.en: scene imaniscavenge26
: Uhh...okay, viewers! It looks like the final object in Futaba’s scavenger hunt is somehow me!
lines.zh: : 呃……好吧，观众朋友们！看来 Futaba 寻宝赛上最后一样东西，不知怎么居然是我！

lines.en: : Which means it looks like I have lost.
lines.zh: : 这意味着我好像输了。

lines.en: : Not yet, Otoha! Futaba needs to reveal her card before we can find out whether or not I even relate to it and-
lines.zh: : 还不一定，Otoha！Futaba 得先亮出她的卡片，我们才能知道那东西到底和我有没有关系，然后——

lines.en: scene imaniscavenge27
: My final card is “something beautiful.” And it was the easiest one of all because the most beautiful woman I know has been right here all along.
lines.zh: : 我最后一张卡片是「美丽的东西」。而这是所有卡片里最容易的一张，因为我认识的最美丽的女人，一直都在这里。

lines.en: : I don’t want to ruin the moment because Imani is definitely beautiful, but saying it was the easiest one when we also had cards like “sword” and “forklift” isn’t really doing much.
lines.zh: : 我不想破坏这个气氛，因为 Imani 确实很美，可在我们还有「剑」和「叉车」这类卡片的情况下，说它是最容易的一张，其实也没多大说服力。

lines.en: scene imaniscavenge28
: That’s true. I’ve never been great at giving speeches, so having to do this in front of millions of live viewers is somewhat daunting, but...
lines.zh: : 确实。我从来不擅长讲话，所以当着数百万现场观众的面说这些，多少有点让人发怵，不过……

lines.en: : If Miss Imai can hear how all of {i}us{/i} feel about her, I think that would make everyone really happy.
lines.zh: : 如果 Imai 老师能听见{i}我们{/i}所有人对她的感受，我觉得那会让大家非常开心。

lines.en: : No objections from me. Because, even though I lost the competition, I got to drive a forklift. Which means I'm the {i}real{/i} winner when all is said and done.
lines.zh: : 我没有异议。因为虽然我输了比赛，但我开到了叉车。也就是说，说到底我才是{i}真正{/i}的赢家。

lines.en: : Uhh...
: I mean...
lines.zh: : 我的意思是……

lines.en: : I guess...that might count...maybe...
lines.zh: : 我想……这大概也算吧……也许……

lines.en: : It counts, Imani. All of us are well aware of how hot you are.
lines.zh: : 当然算，Imani。我们所有人都很清楚你有多辣。

lines.en: : It’s hard to ignore it, to be honest. It’s almost distracting sometimes.
lines.zh: : 说实话，这很难忽视。有时候简直让人分心。

lines.en: : {i}Sometimes?{/i} We’ve got two of the most attractive teachers in the whole damn world. {i}That’s{/i} why all of our grades are bad. It’s not just us.
lines.zh: : {i}有时候{/i}？我们可是有全世界最辣的两位老师。我们的成绩差{i}就是因为这{/i}。这可不怪我们。

lines.en: : It’s not “just you” in the first place. Only a handful of you have bad grades. The rest of us are actually near the top of the school.
lines.zh: : 本来就不是「只怪你们」。成绩差的只是你们中的少数人。我们其余的人其实都排在全校前列。

lines.en: : Shh! We’re talking about how cute Imani is right now! Grade stuff can wait!
lines.zh: : 嘘！我们现在在聊 Imani 有多可爱！成绩的事以后再说！

lines.en: : Imani! We love you and you make us feel things!
lines.zh: : Imani！我们爱你，你让我们心里小鹿乱撞！

lines.en: scene sky
: Hey! How come I get in trouble whenever I say stuff like that but you can all do it whenever you want?!
lines.zh: : 嘿！凭什么我说这种话就要挨骂，你们却能随口就说？！

lines.en: : Context is important, Kirin. And I say this as someone who routinely sodomizes it.
lines.zh: : 语境很重要，Kirin。而说这话的我，可是经常糟蹋语境的人。

lines.en: : Nodoka’s right. Like, a scavenger hunt card that says “something beautiful?” Cool. Just telling her you want to fuck her in the middle of math? {i}Not{/i} cool.
lines.zh: : Nodoka 说得对。寻宝卡片上写「美丽的东西」？很酷。可是在数学课上直接跟她说你想睡她？{i}不{/i}酷。

lines.en: : I can’t help when the feelings arise, Noriko! I’ve been fucking affection starved lately and I’m going through withdrawal!
lines.zh: : 感情涌上来我又控制不了，Noriko！我最近他妈缺爱缺得要命，正在经历戒断反应！

lines.en: : Curious. I wonder what sort of developments there have been lately that could have led to a decrease of affection aimed toward Kirin?
lines.zh: : 有意思。我倒想知道，最近究竟发生了什么变化，导致投向 Kirin 的爱意减少了？

lines.en: : It doesn’t matter what {i}developments{/i} there have been, Makoto! What matters is that you should all say nice things about {i}me{/i} now since Imani’s already gotten her five minutes of fame.
lines.zh: : 发生了什么{i}变化{/i}根本不重要，Makoto！重要的是，既然 Imani 已经享受完她的五分钟成名时间，你们现在都该来说{i}我{/i}的好话。

lines.en: : K-Kirin’s right! Go...say nice things about her or whatever. Futaba wins the...scavenger thing and...I’m gonna...I’m gonna see what I can do about this forklift.
lines.zh: : K……Kirin 说得对！去……说她的好话什么的吧。Futaba 赢得了……寻宝赛，然后……我要……我要去看看这辆叉车该怎么处理。

And so we pass the half-way point of the Super Mega Ultimate Sports-Day Dorm Wars: No Boys Allowed! The Extremely Awesome and Only Kind of Sad Special Event for Bonding and Battling!
